title: Happy client: Home cleaning after moving in
prompt:
A vertical 9:16 UGC-style testimonial ad filmed on a phone for a local service business in Rwanda. Setting: a bright Kigali home. Light: natural window light. Music: warm, light beat.
0-4s: Handheld selfie-style shot at arm's length, natural handheld phone camera with a slight shake: a friendly fictional Rwandan woman in her twenties shows the finished Home cleaning after moving in result to the camera, delighted.
4-8s: Medium shot, waist up, handheld: the presenter walks around and points at the details.
8-10s: Clean hero shot, subject centred, locked-off static camera: the presenter gives a thumbs up. The presenter says to the camera in English: "Book your spot at Urugo Homes."
No on-screen text or added logos.
notes: No product photo: Seedance will imagine the Home cleaning after moving in from the words. Add a photo as Image 1 so it looks exactly like yours.
The presenter is a fictional person described in words, so the face changes between clips. Pick a digital character from the library for the same face every time.
